decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits at the core of the firm's announced display focus and needed little extra investment, so management sees no reason to abandon a course it has publicly committed to, even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.

The pegboard-back shelf display extends the core range the firm has promoted, and weak demand can still be blamed on temporary pandemic-related disruption in retail promotions, so management persists.
The standard quarter-pallet display is central to the one-stop display offering, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated direction and earlier decisions.
The eighth-pallet display completes the pallet-size range the firm has committed to publicly, and its production costs are sunk in existing capacity, which makes withdrawal hard to justify.

The wooden pallet display required dedicated investment in a new material, and that commitment, together with its earlier public presentation, inclines management to persist and attribute uncertain results to temporary market conditions.
